note: 2.1.272 runs a haiku helper on EVERY call: modelUsage names claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 AND claude-fable-5 even on a realistic ERIS-shaped prompt (a trivial prompt showed the same). Under the exactly-one-name rule this made model_executed None on every claude call, refusing the cache and breaking the paired design. The fix that survived panel review is the output-token identity in parse_claude (_executor_by_output_tokens, 2026-09-14): the unique model whose own outputTokens equals the result's usage.output_tokens - here helper 17, primary 450 == 450. An earlier requested-appears-in-usage rule in run_worker was REJECTED by a three-family panel as unsupported and reverted before landing.
